description: This file contains Google Test unit tests for the Rectangle class, verifying its comparison, combining, containment, and overlap methods.

classes.name: Rectangle
classes.description: A class representing a rectangular area, with methods for comparison, combining, checking containment, and overlap.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Checks if two rectangles are equal.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Checks if two rectangles are not equal.

methods.name: operator&
methods.description: Returns the intersection of two rectangles.

methods.name: operator|
methods.description: Returns the union of two rectangles.

methods.name: combine
methods.description: Combines two rectangles into a bounding rectangle.

methods.name: Contains
methods.description: Checks if the rectangle contains a point.
